transcript.content: Hi, welcome in — I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, Dr. [Name], I came in because... lately I keep catching myself thinking that it might just be easier if I didn't wake up. I mean, I haven't made any actual plans to hurt myself or anything like that. It's just this thought that keeps popping into my head, and it's starting to bother me.
Can you tell me how long you've been having these thoughts and feeling this way—days, weeks, months, or longer?

Well, let me think... it's been a few months now. I'd say this low spell has been hanging on for about three months. Yeah, right around three months, ever since that crash I had. It just kind of settled in then and hasn't really lifted.

Before this low period started, have you ever had a stretch of time—days or longer—where you felt unusually energetic, euphoric, or needed much less sleep than usual, even if it felt good at the time?

Yeah, actually... right before the crash, I did have a stretch like that. I had a ton of energy. I was just kind of bouncing from job applications to sketching out these new woodworking projects, and then I'd jump right over to rewriting my resume. I was hardly sitting still long enough to finish one thing before I was already starting the next. It felt pretty good at the time, just having all that going on, so... yeah, I definitely had a lot more energy than usual.
How long did that period of high energy and being unusually active last—was it just a day or two, or did it continue for several days or more?

Well, it definitely wasn't just a day or two. That whole high-energy, kind of out-of-control stretch... it lasted for about three weeks. It started right after I got fired from my job, and it just kept going for those three weeks before the crash hit.
During those three weeks of high energy, did you find you needed much less sleep than usual but still didn't feel tired?

Yeah, that's exactly how it was. There were several nights during that time where I only slept maybe two or three hours. But I didn't feel tired at all. I'd get up feeling like I had a full tank, you know? Just ready to go with absolutely no reason to slow down.

During this past three months of feeling low, have you experienced anything like hearing voices, seeing things that others don't see, or having beliefs that others have told you aren't true or seem unusual?

No, not during these last three months. The only time I experienced anything like that was during those wired weeks right after I got fired. Back then, I was hearing this store-manager voice, and I felt just... unreal certain that I could walk in and take over any store out there. But once I crashed into this low spell, the voice stopped completely. Honestly, I was just left feeling pretty embarrassed by the things I actually believed.
